messages:
Alex Chen: Hey all — just finished onboarding checklist but can't reach internal dashboard at https://internal.redwood.ai while on the company VPN. browser times out. VPN status says "Connected (split-tunnel)". Anyone seen this?
Marie (IT): Hi Alex — welcome! Usually split-tunnel is fine for public internet but internal subnets need a route pushed. Can you paste the output of `ipconfig /all` (Windows) or `ip route` (mac/linux)? Also what OS are you on? :wave:
Alex Chen: macOS Ventura 13.5. Running from home. `ip route` gives: 
```
default via 192.168.1.1 dev en0
10.8.0.0/24 via 10.8.0.1 dev utun0
```
No 10.0.x routes for internal services.
Samir Patel: Are you trying to hit the internal dashboard IP or a hostname? If hostname, DNS is often split too. Try `dig internal-dashboard.service.redwood` or `ping` to check name resolution.
Alex Chen: ping just resolves to 10.0.12.45 but packets time out. traceroute stops at 10.8.0.1.
Jordan (Infra): Looks like the VPN client isn't receiving the VPC route. Which VPN client did you install (WireGuard, OpenVPN, enterprise client)? Also check the client profile — sometimes we ship two profiles: split-tunnel and full.
Alex Chen: Using corp-opvpn.pkg from the quickstart (it said "Redwood VPN").
it-bot: A new internal IT ticket has been created: #IT-4821 for Alex Chen (automated).
Marie (IT): Thanks — I see your account in the provisioning portal. Two quick checks: 1) Did you accept the new network policy prompt after installing? 2) Do you see a route for `10.0.0.0/8` or `10.0.12.0/24` in `netstat -rn` or `ip route`? If not, I'll push the route.
Alex Chen: I missed the policy prompt earlier, restarted the client and still no extra routes. `netstat -rn` shows only utun0 to 10.8.0.0/24.
Marie (IT): OK I'm going to push a per-user route for your account and add your workstation's client ID to the internal allowlist. Reconnect after I tell you. Should take ~2 mins.
Jordan (Infra): FYI if the route push doesn't land you can also SSH via bastion as a temporary workaround: `ssh -J alex@bastion.redwood.internal ec2-user@10.0.12.45` — that'll get you to the box without changing VPN policy.
Samir Patel: Also if you're on mac and using Rosetta apps or Docker, sometimes Docker's networking interferes; try disabling Docker and test again.
Marie (IT): Route pushed. Please disconnect and reconnect your VPN now and then `ping 10.0.12.45` and `curl -v https://internal.redwood.ai/health`.
Alex Chen: Reconnected. `ping` now gets replies (ttl=64) and curl returns HTTP/200! :tada: Thanks everyone.
Marie (IT): Great — I also updated your onboarding checklist entry and noted the need to accept the network policy prompt. If you want SSH access through the bastion, @Jordan can add a key for you.
Jordan (Infra): Happy to — drop me your public key in a DM and I'll add it to the `new-hires` temporary group.
Alex Chen: Will do. And thanks for the quick help — saved me from staring at logs for an hour.
Samir Patel: Welcome to Redwood, Alex! If you run into the registry pulling issue later, ping #help or me directly.
Marie (IT): Closing ticket IT-4821 since we confirmed connectivity. Reopen if anything else breaks. :white_check_mark:
